text: dsh-cookie-sweep 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面辅助插件，会在启动时检查 Electron 网络目录中的 Cookie 文件，并按配置清理识别出的残留数据库。设置页提供逐文件状态、最近清理记录和手动清理按钮；清理包含有限重试与复核。它适合遇到请求头过大、Web 登录页面无法完成认证的桌面用户。默认使用本机 APPDATA 路径，可配置额外目录；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-cookie-sweep cleans recognized leftover Electron login-cookie files from local desktop network folders at startup. Its settings panel shows per-file results and offers manual cleanup. It uses APPDATA by default, accepts extra local paths, and needs no API key or external service.
DSH 桌面端登录页一直认证失败，能自动清理残留的登录 Cookie 吗？
我想在设置里查看每个 Cookie 文件的清理状态，并能手动再清一次。
Can DSH clear stale desktop login-cookie files at startup and show which files were removed?
dsh-cookie-sweep 的功能「启动清理」：插件启用且开启 onStartup 时，会检查本地 Electron 网络目录中的 Cookie 数据库并尝试清理，随后复核文件状态。
dsh-cookie-sweep 的功能「设置页状态与手动清理」：设置面板显示检查目录、逐文件结果和最近记录，并提供立即清理及刷新状态操作。
dsh-cookie-sweep 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 11 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · dsh-cookie-sweep：[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

每次启动自动清掉 DSH 桌面端网络目录里残留的登录 cookie 文件，避免它们越攒越多、把请求头撑过 16KB，
被服务端 431 退回，界面永久停在 “Web authentication failed”。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · 为什么需要它：桌面端把 cookie 持久化在下面这些位置：

```
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Partitions\<分区>\Network\
```

启动次数一多，这些文件只增不减。攒到一定程度，每次请求头都会超过常见的 16KB 上限，服务端直接回 431，
Web 界面就再也登录不上。手动修法是彻底退出 DSH、删掉 `Cookies` 与 `Cookies-journal`、再打开；
这个插件把这一步变成自动的。登录态本身在 `.dsh` 目录里，不受影响。

> 症状对照：启动大约 72 次之后彻底打不开、报 `Web authentication failed`；浏览器网络面板里请求头
> 超过 16KB、服务端回 **431**。如果清理后仍打不开，先确认是不是同一个原因。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · 它做什么：- **启动时清理**：插件被加载时（也就是 DSH 启动时）清一次 `Cookies` / `Cookies-journal`
  （可选连 `Trust Tokens` 一起清）。删除失败会重试约 6 秒，因为正在退出的进程要过一会儿才放开句柄。
- **状态页**：设置 → **Cookie 清理**，逐文件显示 `已删除 / 不存在 / 被占用 / 已跳过 / 已重建`、大小与原因，
  并有一个「立即清理」按钮。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · 安全边界：删除是不可逆的，所以这里刻意保守： - 只在 `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\\Network` 与 `Partitions\

\Network` 里动手，路径由插件自己拼出。 - 只删固定名单里的文件名，绝不通配。 - 非空文件必须在开头看到 SQLite 或 LevelDB 的 cookie 库签名才会删；不像就跳过并在状态里说明。 - `Partitions\temp-*`（一次性会话）一律不碰，避免打乱正在进行的登录流程。 - 任何失败都只写进状态，绝不让插件拖垮启动。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · 配置：`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `config`：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关；关掉后启动不清、手动清理也不可用 |
| `onStartup` | `true` | 每次启动自动清一次 |
| `keepTrustTokens` | `true` | 只清 Cookies，保留 Trust Tokens |
| `extraPaths` | `[]` | 额外的 Electron 网络目录（绝对路径） |

`window.__ModuleLoader__` 加载的普通模块。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · 已知限制：- 运行中的应用会独占主 `Network\Cookies`，所以**本次运行期间**启动清理大概率会报“被占用”。
  把它彻底退出（含托盘）再打开，下一次启动就是在文件被放开之前动手的。
- 主库被占用且应用随后重建它时，状态会显示“已重建”而不是“已删除”——那不是失败，只是它又被新建了。
- 清掉 cookie 库可能要在下次启动时重新授权一次；`.dsh` 里的会话记录不受影响。

dsh-cookie-sweep README · dsh-cookie-sweep：English | [中文](./README.md)

A DSH desktop plugin that sweeps the leftover login-cookie files out of the Electron network
directory on every start, so they can never pile up past the 16KB request-header limit and lock the
Web UI on `Web authentication failed` behind an HTTP 431.

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Why it exists：The desktop app persists its cookies here:

```
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Partitions\<partition>\Network\
```

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Why it exists：Those files only ever grow. After enough launches, every request header crosses the common 16KB
limit, the server answers 431, and the interface can no longer authenticate. The manual remedy is
to quit DSH, delete `Cookies` and `Cookies-journal`, and reopen — this plugin automates exactly that
step. The login state itself lives in `.dsh` and is untouched.

dsh-cookie-sweep README · What it does：- **Sweep at startup**: when the plugin loads (that is, when DSH starts) it deletes `Cookies` and
  `Cookies-journal` — optionally `Trust Tokens` too. A delete that fails is retried for about six
  seconds, because a process that is still exiting has not released the handle yet.
- **Status page**: Settings → **Cookie 清理 / Cookie Sweep** lists every candidate file with
  `deleted / absent / in use / skipped / recreated`, its size and the reason, plus a **Clean now**
  button.

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Safety boundaries：- It only acts inside `%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\\Network` and `Partitions\

\Network`, with paths it builds itself. - It only deletes a fixed list of file names — never a glob. - A non-empty file is deleted only when its head carries a SQLite or LevelDB cookie-store signature. Anything else is skipped and explained in the status page. - `Partitions\temp-*` (one-shot sessions) is never touched, so an in-progress sign-in is not disturbed. - Every failure is recorded in the status page; nothing here is allowed to break app startup.

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Configuration：The `config` block in `cordis.patch.yml`:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; with it off nothing is swept at startup and manual cleaning is refused |
| `onStartup` | `true` | Sweep once at every start |
| `keepTrustTokens` | `true` | Leave `Trust Tokens` alone and sweep only the cookies |
| `extraPaths` | `[]` | Extra Electron network directories (absolute paths) |

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Install：From a local checkout:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cookie-sweep
      name: 'dsh-cookie-sweep'
      config:

or point the plugin manager at the package directory:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle <absolute path to this directory>
```

The package has no runtime dependencies; `index.js` uses only Node built-ins and `client.js` is a
plain module loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`.

dsh-cookie-sweep README · Known limits：- A running app holds an exclusive handle on the main `Network\Cookies`, so during the *current*
  run the startup sweep will usually report “in use”. Quit DSH completely (tray included) and
  reopen: the next start sweeps before the file is taken.
- When the main store is held and the app then recreates it, the status says `recreated` rather than
  `deleted` — that is not a failure, just the file being written again.
- Deleting the cookie store can cost one re-authorization. The conversation history in `.dsh` is not
  affected.
